zoe: Quick readout for Silverspar POC run — mixed chat+embed (60/40). Posting config and top-line numbers.

marc: paste the harness and headline so I can update the quote.

zoe: config: model=redwood-13b-8k-quant, infra=dedicated-2xA100, concurrency target=150, batch_target=14, kv_cache=on, prefix_prewarm=off (baseline). runner=k6 with poisson + 20s microbursts to 270 qps.

ian: SLA ask was p95 < 400ms for chat, right?

zoe: baseline 30m soak: sustained 115 qps; chat p50=260ms, chat p95=700ms; embeddings p95=180ms; burst error rate=4.2%; GPU util avg=71%; mem headroom~9GB; rough cost delta ~$0.64/1k chat tokens.

marc: 700ms p95 is bad. Root causes?

zoe: ingress queueing on bursts, some kernel tail traces on 2 workers, and cold prefix misses for rarer prompts. Low-effort mitigations to try: 1) enable prefix prewarm for top-120 prompts, 2) lower batch_target to 12 for burst windows, 3) short-lived burst worker (+1) when qps>150.

ops-bot: [automated] autoscale suggestion created: RB-99881 by zoe. policy: +1 worker when 1m avg qps >150, cooldown 3m. link: https://console.redwood.example/rb/99881

z oe: running primed+batch=12 now. will post results.

zoe: follow-up (3265432135) after 20m primed run: chat p95 dropped to 390ms (within target), p50=245ms, embeddings p95 ~170ms, burst drop rate 0.9%, incremental burst buffer estimate +$1.8k/mo; uploaded CSV+flame graphs to deal folder.

rachel: great — we'll present priming + burst buffer as baseline and offer eng-runtime tuning as optional paid work if they want further tail reduction.

marc: I'll update the pricing sheet and SOW. Closing loop unless runtime needs to be pulled in. :white_check_mark:
